shared_elements: animals rendered in low/raised relief on a large stone surface
multiple animal figures crowded on one face
schematic animal heads with pronounced snout
justification: Both surfaces are covered with multiple relief animal figures, chiefly quadrupeds seen in profile with prominent schematic heads and snouts, plus what may be elongated serpentine forms, which is a real if fairly broad correspondence. However, A organises its creatures into neat stacked registers separated by a woven/zigzag band, with distinct large birds and small anthropomorph-like figures, while B has a single dominant high-relief beast dominating an unstructured, curved field with the other creatures crowded around it in no register order.
